info.title: IPX 800 V5 API Core
info.description: This is a document to describe core API requests to manage your IPX 800 V5.

get.description:
Recover a table of all IOs in IPX (config + state)

    {
        "_id": 65577,
        "name": "[Thermostat USER]No Frost",
        "link0": 0,
        "link1": 1638400,
        "virtual": false,
        "on": false
    }

link0.description: Updated link0 to bind this IO with input of other object

link1.description: Updated link0 to bind this IO with output of other object

requestBody.description:
It is possible to init new IO object with a body. 
Only name, link0 and link1 will be updated

post.description: Create new IO in IPX with or without parameters

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID provided by IPX when this object was created

requestBody.description:
In order to modify an IO, the element to be modified must be indicated in the body.
Only name and on can be changed.

io_all.description: Array of all IO object (sytem + virtual)

_usage.description:
Usage of a collection of object :
* **capacity**: Number maximum of object in IPX
* **usage**: Percentage of object used
* **used**: Number of object used
* **usedSubGroup1**: (optional) Number of sub-group object 
* **usedSubGroup2**: (optional) Number of sub-group object 
* **usedSubGroup3**: (optional) Number of sub-group object 
* **usedSubGroup4**: (optional) Number of sub-group object 
* **usedSubGroup5**: (optional) Number of sub-group object 
* **bCorrupted**: Flag to indicate if collection of object is corrupted (invalid flash configuration)

_info.description:
Informations about a collection object :
* **apiVersion**: version of object API
* **objVersion**: version of object configuration
